## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Created from the mobile simulator audit of MDV-P5-053, findings M-04, C-21.

Findings and evidence: docs/product-ux-audit/13-mobile-simulator-audit.md, findings M-04, C-21, with screenshots of synthetic cast data in docs/product-ux-audit/evidence/mobile-simulator.
Components affected: packages/tokens (one map), packages/ui and packages/ui-native status chips. No new component.
Prerequisites and blocked by: MDV-P5-053. Not in the pilot flow: the pilot runs on the web app.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: real data in the apps (MDV-P5-033) and store builds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a status, when it is shown on web and on native, then both use the same glyph and words from one map in packages/tokens
- [ ] **AC2.** Given an allergy, when its chip is shown on native, then it reads Allergy: <substance> with a glyph not used for medicines
- [ ] **AC3.** Given any status, when shown, then it is never conveyed by colour alone (icon and words)

## Test notes

- ui-native or app unit tests for the changed behaviour; a simulator check recorded on the PR with synthetic data only.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
